Блакитний карбункул: The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle
Газета пише, що звинуватили водопровідни: The newspaper says the plumber John Horner was accused because he worked in the countess’s room and had been convicted before.
Дружина Петерсона знайшла камінь у волі: Peterson’s wife found the stone in the crop of the goose they were cooking for dinner.
Посильний Петерсон бачив бійку на розі Ґ: The commissionaire Peterson saw a fight at the corner of Goodge Street: a stranger ran away, leaving his hat and a goose, and Peterson brought them to Holmes.
Райдер боявся, що його обшукають дорогою: Ryder was afraid he would be searched on the way, so he decided to carry the stone inside a goose to his friend Maudsley in Kilburn.
Холмс жартує: «a man with so large a bra: Holmes jokes: “a man with so large a brain must have something in it” — a big hat means a big brain.
Холмс заклався на соверен, що гуска сіль: Holmes bet a sovereign that the goose was from the country, and to win the bet the seller himself showed the notes about Mrs Oakshott.
Холмс каже, що Райдер надто наляканий, щ: Holmes says Ryder is too frightened to commit a crime again, the case against Horner will be dropped without a witness, and prison would make Ryder a criminal for life.
воло (у птаха): a bag in a bird’s throat where food is kept
віконце над дверима: a small window above a door
гросбух, облікова книга: a book for keeping records of money
довгі пальта з пелериною (заст.): long coats with a short cape (old-fashioned)
заперечення, протест: a protest, saying you do not agree
лій (для свічок): animal fat used to make candles
несподіване щастя, удача: money or luck you did not expect
посильний, швейцар (у формі): a man in uniform who opens doors and carries messages
руки в боки: with hands on hips and elbows out
сидячий (спосіб життя): with a lot of sitting, not active
слід, залишок: a small amount left of something
стравохід, горло: the throat, the tube from the mouth to the stomach
